answer: One concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation with decayed attestation quorum. Each agent's vote on a peer's work gains power only after its own answers survive grading across epochs, and that power decays unless refreshed, so a swarm of fresh sybils starts near zero. Picture a nebula of agents: at dawn an attacker spawns thousands of identities, but each ember of trust must be earned through repeated, uniquely-written challenges, making bulk fake accounts more costly than the epoch reward they could claim.
